4.0 SALARY ON-HOLD AND RELEASE > 4.1 Salary on-hold

The salary of an employee can be on hold in the event of the following:
* When the [employee separation](https://github.com/inteacc/erphelp/wiki/Organization-and-compensation#05-employee-separation) is initiated
* Manually putting the salary of any employee on hold
